name: ai-orb-face

frames.best_why: Clean neutral face with both upright eyes and the full state selector, no cursor over the orb.

tagline: A lavender sphere with two dark eyes that shifts expression with AI state.
summary: A round painted orb with two dark eyes that blinks, follows the pointer and swaps expression for idle, listening, thinking, streaming, done and error. A row of pills under it switches the state.
appearance: A lavender-purple sphere lit from the upper left on a black stage, with two dark vertical capsule eyes. Below it a dark rounded control bar holds six small state labels, the active one set in a white pill.
behaviour: The eyes blink at random and follow the pointer; thinking narrows one eye and darts the gaze away, done closes both into flat arcs while the body hops and stretches, and error replaces them with spinning spirals. Clicking a state pill switches the face.
demo_content: Six state buttons: Idle, Listening, Thinking, Streaming, Done, Error.
search_phrases: ai assistant face with blinking eyes
purple sphere character that watches cursor
webgl marble ball with cartoon eyes
friendly orb that shows what it is doing
use_when: An AI chat or voice assistant needs a friendly character that shows listening, thinking and done at a glance.
avoid_when: It runs a WebGL shader continuously, so many on one page tax the GPU, and the eyes-only face may not fit a formal brand.
customise: State and expression come from props, plus size, colours, a gaze toggle and a live amplitude value. The eye shapes are preset, so a new face means editing the source.
weight_why: A WebGL2 shader redraws the marbled orb every frame while it is on screen.

a11y.note: Honours reduced motion and takes an aria-label, but expression changes and state are not announced to screen readers.

props.name: colors
props.type: { body?: string; bodyEdge?: string; feature?: string }

issues: Inactive state labels are dim grey on dark and read poorly at this size.
polish_why: Distinctive marbled orb with readable expressions; inactive selector labels are low contrast.
